 Tue, 27 October 2026 
 By TRN Online , Kathmandu, Oct 27: Chitwan Rhinos set 158 runs target for Biratnagar Kings in the 2nd match of the NPL 3rd season being played at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kritipur, today.
 Chitwan Rhinos put 157 runs in 20 overs with a loss of 3 wickets. Dawid Malan scored 70 runs in 50 balls, Ravi Bopara scored 32 runs in 26 balls, Dev Khanal scored 12 runs in 15 balls, Arjun Saud scored 3 runs in 9 balls and Dan Mousley scored 29 runs in 22 balls. 
 For Biratnagar Kings, Angelo Mathews, Andre Russell and Charith Asalanka took one-one wicket each.
